required_documents.name: SF424 (R&R) Application Package
required_documents.details: Standard application form package for federal assistance with applicant business credentials.

required_documents.name: Project Summary / Abstract
required_documents.details: Overview of Phase IIB breakthrough research and clinical commercialization milestones (max 30 lines).
required_documents.source: PA-27-101-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 SF424(R&R) Other Project Information

required_documents.name: Project Narrative
required_documents.details: Statement describing the relevance of the breakthrough technology to public health outcomes.
required_documents.source: PA-27-101-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 SF424(R&R) Other Project Information

required_documents.name: R&R Senior/Key Person Profiles
required_documents.details: Biographical sketches for PD/PI and key scientific/regulatory staff (max 5 pages each).
required_documents.source: PA-27-101-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 Senior/Key Person Profile

required_documents.name: R&R Detailed Budget and Justification
required_documents.details: Detailed budget outlining federal request and required 1:1 matching non-federal expenditure categories.

required_documents.name: Cost Match Documentation & Investor Commitments
required_documents.details: Letters of binding commitment from third-party investors, foundations, or state matching programs documenting the 100% cost match.
required_documents.source: PA-27-101-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section III.2 and Section IV.2

required_documents.name: Specific Aims
required_documents.details: One page defining Phase IIB strategic breakthrough aims.
required_documents.source: PA-27-101-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 PHS 398 Research Plan

required_documents.name: Research Strategy
required_documents.details: Maximum 12 pages describing Significance, Innovation, and Approach for advancing technology toward FDA clearance or commercial deployment.

required_documents.name: Commercialization Plan
required_documents.details: Comprehensive 12-page commercialization roadmap detailing market opportunity, IP protection, manufacturing, and capital requirements.
required_documents.source: PA-27-101-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 PHS 398 Research Plan

required_documents.name: Registrations (SAM.gov, Grants.gov, eRA Commons, SBIR.gov)
required_documents.details: Active institutional registrations in SAM.gov, Grants.gov, eRA Commons, and SBA Company Registry.

deadlines.when: September 5, 2026, 5:00 p.m. local time of applicant organization
January 5, 2027, 5:00 p.m. local time of applicant organization
April 5, 2027, 5:00 p.m. local time of applicant organization

eligibility.summary: Small business concerns that have previously received an SBIR or STTR Phase II award and submit within six due dates after Phase II budget expiration. NC small biotech/medtech companies with completed Phase II awards are eligible.

cost_share.details: Requires 100% cost sharing (1:1 dollar-for-dollar non-federal match) as defined in the NIH Grants Policy Statement under the Small Business Innovation and Economic Security Act.

submission_limits: Only one Phase IIB award is allowed per project.
important_notes: Mandatory 1:1 non-federal matching funds required; applications without verifiable matching commitments are ineligible.
Must be submitted within the first six standard due dates following expiration of the prior Phase II project period.
Only one Phase IIB award can be made for a given project.
